messages:
alex: Heads-up — we might need 4 A100s in ap-northeast1 for a customer demo Sat 06:00 UTC (that's 15:00 JST). Can someone confirm quota + any spare capacity we can borrow?

sam: I can check pool usage now. Last I saw we had 2 free A100s in the dev-demo pool, but they're not reserved. If we need 4, we'll either borrow from reserved or spin up temporary spot H100s as fallback.

maria: tagging @taylor since the demo is tied to the demo account that taylor set up. Also FYI the infra-allocations sheet shows vendor quota left = 6 in region but 2 are in pending provisioning.

alex: @sam thx. If you can lock 2 and confirm fallback plan (H100 spot or swap from eu-west), that'd be ideal. Demo cannot tolerate >200ms extra latency but can accept slightly different GPU if we adjust batch sizes.

sam: quick check command for anyone who wants to verify quotas: `gcloud compute regions describe ap-northeast1 --format="table(quotas.metric,quotas.limit,quotas.usage)"`

sam: Ran it — output snippet:
```
NAME            LIMIT  USAGE
NVIDIA_TESLA_A100  50     48
NVIDIA_H100       24     12
```
Looks like we're tight on A100 headroom.

taylor: I pushed a tiny PR to request short-term borrow + reserve for demo: https://git.internal/repo/infra/terraform/pull/456 — it adds a 4-instance temporary reservation and tags them with `demo-weekend/apac`. Can someone review?

alex: Reviewing now. One ask: can we avoid creating new images? Use existing `redwood-demo-2025-02` AMI — fewer startup surprises.

maria: @taylor please add the AMI tag and a shutdown hook at +6h in the TF module. Also add a cost-center label `cost:center=demo-eng`.

taylor: will do. Updating PR in a few mins.

jia: (vendor-side) ETA for hardware handoff is ~36h if we request spot->on-demand conversion. If you need hard guarantee, we can cut a short-term committed block but that needs procurement signoff.

procurement-bot: Vendor quota change request submitted: ticket #P-1987. Current status: awaiting approval from finance. Estimated approval 24-48h.

alex: Hmm — that might be tight for Sat demo. Sam, can we try swapping workload to H100s with a config patch? I can tweak batch to keep latency.

sam: Yes — quick strategy: reserve 2 A100s (low risk), and spin 2 H100 spot instances as warm fallback. Patch is small, see snippet: `--env BATCH_SIZE=8 --env KV_CACHE=true` and pin model perf profile `model: redwood/lite-4096-q8`.

maria: Don't forget networking: if H100s land in a different subnet, add `--allow-internal-demo` security rule for the demo account. I can pre-create the rule.

alex: Great — plan: (1) @sam reserve 2 A100s; (2) @taylor update PR with AMI + shutdown hook + cost tag; (3) @maria create the security rule; (4) @jia escalate vendor ticket if procurement approval stalls.

sam: On it. I'll lock 2 and post instance IDs in this thread once done. ETA 12m.

taylor: PR updated: added `ami = "redwood-demo-2025-02"`, shutdown cron `at +360m`, and `labels = {"cost:center" = "demo-eng"}`. Link same PR.

maria: Security rule created: `allow-internal-demo-apac` (TCP 1024-65535 between demo subnets).

sam: Locked 2 A100s: instances `a100-demo-11` and `a100-demo-12`. Also spun up 2 H100 spot warmers: `h100-warm-01` and `h100-warm-02` (they're idle).

alex: :thumbsup: Awesome — please also add a short playbook note in the demo runbook: fallback -> switch endpoint to h100 instances, reduce batch by 25%.

maria: I added the note to Confluence. Link: https://wiki.internal/redwood/demo-runbook#apac-weekend

procurement-bot: Update: finance approved expedited block for 4 GPUS for 48h; ticket #P-1987 now `approved-pending-billing`.

alex: Excellent. Thanks all. I'll run a smoke test at 05:15 UTC Sat and ping this thread with results.

sam: ping me when you do, I'll be oncall.

alex: Will do.

(END)
